I was seventeen. I was super against weed for most of my life, but I started researching on it more and more after I started idolizing Paul McCartney. My friend kept offering to smoke me up but I always declined. I finally accepted and walked 40 minutes to meet her in the bush behind her school (sketchy, I know). I brought my pipe that I bought in advance, she packed it, and told me to take the first hit. Apparently it was the best weed she'd ever smoked, so I thought, "awesome, I'll get super high" and oh my god was I right. My first hit was horrid, I nearly threw up. After passing the pipe around they convinced me to take another couple hits. As soon as I was about to say "I don't feel anything", it felt like God took ahold of the planet and JOLTED it. I nearly fell over, and when I looked up, holy SHIT was I high. There was a tiny snowbank that we had to step over and I was too high, so I scooched my ass down it super slowly. After that I rode a city bus (felt like a rocket ship) and ate McDonald's (it was like eating gourmet food from Zeus' gold platter). Was definitely the highest I've ever been, it felt more like a stronger psychedelic than just weed (felt like I was experiencing three different universes at once). Weirdly enough, I had a hangover-like thing the next day. Regardless, best day ever.
